user.title: Elsner weather station
user.description: Set up the USB/RS485 port the weather station is connected to. The sensors appear as soon as the first data packet has been recognised.

data_description.name: Prefix for the names of the sensors.
data_description.serial_port: For example /dev/serial/by-id/... This path stays the same after a restart or replug. /dev/ttyUSB0 can change.
data_description.analyse_interval: Minimum time between two analysed data packets. 0 = analyse every data packet.
